newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE TUESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE TUESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow most of the day on Tuesday, fairly active late, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower than last week.
Inquiry esd moderate and demand light.
Wk to date - 53,000 last week - 82,600 last year - 87,300
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1350 lbs
Dressed Basis - Few Select and Choice 1225 lbs 106.00-106.50
hot weights, delivered. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1150 lbs 65.00. Dressed Basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 105.00-105.50 hot weights, delivered.

Sales confirmed on 12,200 slaughter steers and 10,000 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 53,000 head confirmed including 37,900 head or about 72 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
